title: Seville food tour
text: I took this tour with Gabriella and it was excellent. She was kind and informative. We tried so many good foods and wines. I have a list of items I want to reorder and hope to revisit some of the places we stopped to try more of the menu.
author: Tjcpeters

title: Great tapas tour
text: Gabriela was an amazing guide. She made the tour feel authentic and created an atmosphere where the group felt like a familiar. 10/10 would recommend
author: M1986WRemilyb

title: Delicious!
text: Delicious food and company. Gabriela is amazing and knowledgeable. I highly recommend!
author: lindsayw976

title: Food tour review - sevilla
text: Alejandro was amazing! The tour is what my wife and I would call "Picasso". It is when my wife and I would call or describe something we extremely enjoyed/loved. He took us to amazing local places that had amazing wines and different foods. He had a lot of knowledge of the town's and Spain's history. Would definitely recommend with Alejandro!
author: joeylX5698VY

title: Best Tapas tour in Seville
text:
Amazing Tapas tour with Alex. 10/10!
He took us to 4 lovely Tapas restaurants, flooded us with history and amazing info about the amazing food we were served.
Would definitely recommend this tour to anyone!
author: Wirralexplorer

title: A really helpful and enjoyable experience. i highly recommend it.
text: Alex is a very friendly and interesting guide. I had a fantastic time. Thanks for everything.

title: Amazing food/wine/beer tour!
text: Ferran was great and very knowledgeable. He brought us to some great local places and showed us some very special things along the way between each location. We were with 4 family members along with multiple other couples. We were extremely pleased with our experience and highly recommend this. Food and wine/beer was incredible!
